title: 第1740章 选衣裳第1739章 寻衅挑事
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
这时，他余光瞥见身旁自家娘子也被威压侵扰，面色泛白、周身难受难耐，叶河双拳死死攥紧，指节泛白，
胸中怒火翻涌，胸膛剧烈起伏，周身漆黑晦涩的法则之力层层升腾而起，决意奋力抵挡。
千钧一发之际，笼罩全场的恐怖威压骤然消散一空，尽数褪去。
“前辈莅临永恒古星，晚辈自然满心欢迎，可这般肆意释放威压惊扰全场众人，未免有失分寸了吧？”
忆无情清冷淡然的声音倏然在虚空各处响起，语调裹挟着一丝淡淡的冷意，
可四下搜寻，任凭谁都捕捉不到他的身形踪迹，就连撼天圣尊，亦无法窥见其所在方位。
短暂的沉寂过后，撼天圣尊的声音再度缓缓传来，带着几分讶异与沉吟：
“看来外界种种传言皆非虚妄，你的修为境界，已然抵达这般高度了。”
“是因为，你的至高法吧？”
此言一出，众人都是一怔，有些不解。
“这些话，前辈也不必刻意说出来。”
忆无情的声音中带着一丝随意，
“前辈快些入座吧，不然，就没有属于前辈你的位置了。”
“哼。”
撼天圣尊冷哼一声，便没有在开口。
场上再次恢复平静，好似这个闹剧只是个小插曲。
但，明眼人还是看出来了，方才忆无情，其实隐隐压过撼天圣尊，让撼天圣尊不敢继续找茬。
……
清幽雅致的仙君殿内，晨光透过精致窗棂浅浅洒落，铺满地温柔光晕。
忆无情端坐琉璃镜前，望着镜中自己的模样，眉宇间萦绕着一抹浅浅无奈。

冷清璃与九霄轻语静静立在他身后，两道身姿清雅绝尘，目光齐齐落于镜面之人的身上，
眼底皆是藏不住的惊艳异彩，静静凝望着，未曾出声打扰。
待看清他已然规整完毕的模样，冷清璃眉眼微抬，带着几分真切的讶异，轻声开口：
“无情，我本还想着上前为你细细梳理发髻，不曾想你早已打理妥当。”
一旁的九霄轻语眸光灼灼，定定望着镜中身姿俊朗、风华绝代的人影，红唇轻扬，音色软糯轻柔，满是由衷的赞叹：
“公子真好看。”
她目光细细描摹着他利落雅致的发髻与精巧别致的发饰，眼底光亮愈盛，字字温柔：
“这般风姿，配着这发型、这发饰，恰到好处，绝美无双。”
说着，她伸出纤细白皙的指尖，小心翼翼、轻之又轻地触碰了一下他头顶的发饰，生怕力道过重，扰了这份规整雅致。
叮铃铃——
一声清越空灵的脆响骤然漾开。
content_en:
At this time, he caught a glimpse of his wife beside him who was also being harassed by the pressure. Her face turned pale and her whole body felt unbearable. Ye He clenched his fists tightly and his knuckles turned white.
Anger surged in his chest, his chest heaved violently, and the power of dark and obscure laws rose up layer by layer around him, and he was determined to resist it.
At the critical moment, the terrifying pressure that enveloped the entire place suddenly dissipated and faded away.
"Senior has come to Eternal Ancient Star, and junior will naturally welcome him wholeheartedly, but it would be out of proportion to release his pressure so wantonly and disturb everyone in the audience, right?"
Yi Wuqing's cold and indifferent voice suddenly sounded throughout the void, with a hint of coldness in his tone.
But despite searching everywhere, no one could catch any trace of his figure, and not even the Holy Lord Shaking Heaven could get a glimpse of his location.
After a short silence, the voice of the Holy Lord Shaking the Sky came slowly again, with a bit of surprise and contemplation:
"It seems that all the rumors from the outside world are not false. Your cultivation level has reached such a high level."
"Is it because of your supreme law?"
As soon as this statement came out, everyone was startled and a little confused.
"Senior, there is no need to deliberately say these words."
There was a hint of randomness in Yi Qingqing's voice,
"Senior, hurry up and take your seat, otherwise, there will be no place for you, senior."
"Hmph."
Holy Lord Shaotian snorted coldly and said nothing.
The place was calm again, as if this farce was just a sideshow.
However, those with a discerning eye could still see that Yi Qingqing, who was just now, was actually faintly overwhelming the Holy Lord Shaking the Sky, so that the Holy Lord Shaking the Sky did not dare to continue to find trouble.
…
In the quiet and elegant Xianjun Palace, the morning light shines through the exquisite window lattice, covering the ground with a gentle halo.
Yi Qingqing sat in front of the glass mirror, looking at his own appearance in the mirror, with a hint of helplessness lingering between his eyebrows.
Leng Qingli and Jiuxiao Qingyu stood quietly behind him, their figures were elegant and pure, their eyes fell on the person in the mirror.
There was a stunning brilliance that could not be hidden in his eyes, and he stared quietly without making a sound to disturb him.
After seeing his neatly arranged appearance, Leng Qingli raised her eyebrows slightly, with a bit of genuine surprise, and spoke softly:
"Ring Wu, I was planning to go up and comb your bun carefully, but I never thought that you had already done it properly."
Jiuxiao Qingyu on the side looked at the handsome and elegant figure in the mirror with burning eyes, her red lips slightly raised, her voice soft and soft, full of heartfelt admiration:
"Young Master is so handsome."
Her eyes carefully traced his neat and elegant bun and exquisite and unique hair accessories. Her eyes became brighter and brighter, and her words were gentle:
"Such a graceful look, paired with this hairstyle and hair accessories, just perfect, absolutely beautiful."
As she spoke, she stretched out her slender white fingertips and carefully and gently touched the hair ornaments on his head, fearing that too much force would disturb the orderliness and elegance.
Jingle bell——
A clear and ethereal crisp sound suddenly rippled out.
